subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish a general external-plugin Control UI mutation and chat-navigation bridge, rather than keeping sandboxed gateway-auth tabs read-only?
rationale: This is a new documented SDK, Gateway protocol, and native-client contract with a long-lived security and compatibility boundary; code review cannot determine whether that product surface should exist.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge
options.body: Approve the capability as a public plugin contract, then require Gateway-owned context derivation and exact-head real-browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep tabs read-only
options.body: Retain the existing frame-grant model and route mutation workflows through an already approved owner-specific or trusted-client surface.

options.title: Defer the API decision
options.body: Pause this PR until a plugin and Control UI owner define the supported mutation and navigation contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge
recommendation.body: Approve the capability as a public plugin contract, then require Gateway-owned context derivation and exact-head real-browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently delivered the merged sandboxed external-tab authentication boundary that this proposal extends.
